europe_now.title: Russian Attacks on Kyiv
europe_now.summary: A combined missile and drone strike launched by Russian forces against Kyiv resulted in multiple fatalities and widespread security concerns.

europe_now.title: Poland Investigates Drone-Plant Fire
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities are actively probing whether foreign intelligence agencies were involved in a recent destructive fire at a domestic drone manufacturing facility.

top_stories.title: European Defense Cooperation
top_stories.summary: France and Sweden have formalized a significant bilateral defense pact involving the procurement of naval frigates. European officials continue to coordinate closely on regional security strategy and capability development.

top_stories.title: EU Trade and Regulatory Policy
top_stories.summary: The European Union has moved to suspend specific meat imports from Brazil pending a thorough review of antibiotic compliance standards. Meanwhile, member states are addressing broader international trade frictions and alignment on global forums.
